items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: I played a lot of Parade with Chris Kelly and Rene.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. Yeah, and I played with a lot of them. I played with Kid Rene. I know you heard of Kid Rene.

Sure, yeah. He made some records, right? And I played with Chris Kelly. Oh, yeah. Parade, though. I played a lot of Parade with Chris Kelly and Rene. Of course, Rene and Chris Kelly had their drums. But I was a two-way band. I would play trap drum, snare drum, eat a bass drum, anything they wanted. The few of them I played. When you played with Kid Rene, for instance, who else was in the band? Can you remember sort of the lineup any time? Oh, no. I know they all changed, but can you remember the band? Oh, no. Can…
Can you remember the band? Oh, no. Can you remember the band? Yeah. Can you remember the band? Yeah. Yeah. I know they all changed, but can you remember some of the band?
